title: Superlatives
subtitle: Read the highest degree without over-pressing it.
overview: A superlative marks the highest degree in a group, though Koine usage can sometimes be less sharply absolute than English “the most.”
Identify the noun it qualifies and the group implied by context.

items.grc: ὁ δὲ μείζων ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται ὡς ὁ νεώτερος.
items.en: The greater among you will be as the younger.

items.grc: ὁ ἐλάχιστος ἐν πᾶσιν ὑμῖν οὗτός ἐστιν μέγας.
items.en: The least among all of you is great.
